instruction: Fix `open_text` in `fileops/_open.py` so it opens files as UTF-8 by default. The default encoding is currently ASCII, so reading any non-ASCII file through `read_lines` or `read_dicts` raises `UnicodeDecodeError`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops/_open.py b/fileops/_open.py
--- a/fileops/_open.py
+++ b/fileops/_open.py
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 
 
 @contextmanager
-def open_text(path, mode="r", encoding="ascii", newline=None):
+def open_text(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8", newline=None):
     """Open ``path`` as a text file and yield the handle, closing it on exit."""
     handle = open(path, mode, encoding=encoding, newline=newline)
     try:
